summary:
Set 121 Session 4 of 4, the set-terminal session: the guidance queue is empty of everything that could leave it, every preload ceiling is back at its measurement, and the doc-only severity cap has an evidence-backed verdict for the first time.

(1) PROMOTED C-003 then C-002 out of guidance-candidates.md into project-guidance.md, and registered both in the guidance ledger. C-001 stays queued on its own stated prerequisites (an enforcement lint and a recall check), which is now a merit blocker rather than a space one. L-064-8 needed no admission: Session 1 had already condensed it to a live one-liner.

(2) FUNDED THE PROMOTIONS BY COLLAPSE, not by an exception. Six entries (G-009, G-011, G-014, G-016, G-017, G-021) restated session-constitution.md; both files are preload, so each duplicate was read every session and bought nothing. Full text archived to lessons-archive.md with a table naming where each rule is live. project-guidance.md measures 3,394 tokens, down from 3,645 NET of both admissions. G-018 (path-aware critique) is also a duplicate and was deliberately kept: the spec names its deletion under ceiling pressure as the defect that broke the previous scheme.

(3) RATCHETED EVERY CEILING TO MEASUREMENT and deleted the last accommodation. Total 12,234 -> 11,644; constitution 4,200 -> 4,059; project-guidance 3,645 -> 3,394. The standing operator authorization of 2026-08-12 is deleted from both guidance-lifecycle.md and router-config.yaml, not merely marked retired. The manifest's engine entry MOVED from AGENTS.md to GEMINI.md: the lockstep trim of the three bootstrap files left GEMINI largest, and the manifest must count the largest or it understates what a session reads. That rule existed and had never fired; guidance-lifecycle.md now carries it as a worked example.

(4) RE-DERIVED instruction_line_cap 25 -> 22. S3 was forced to set cap == corpus == 25, which can only fire on the next entry and therefore measures nothing. The collapse left the corpus at 21, back under the measured historical peak, so the evidence-backed number is usable again with one slot of real headroom.

(5) MEASURED THE DOC-ONLY CAP across all four sessions and shipped the measurement as ai_router/measure_doc_only_cap.py so it can be re-run rather than re-derived. THE CAP DID NOT FIRE - not once, in any round, in any session. 23 of 23 findings cited evidencePaths (100%), zero were doc-only, and 13 of 23 (57%) were MIXED doc-and-code, up from the 38% measured while the spec was written. Netting out the phased supplementary round, sessions 1-3 ran 5/4/3 - a median of exactly the pre-cap 4.0, so the cap moved rounds neither way because it never applied. A finding that it did not fire was a declared successful outcome of this step.

(6) DID NOT WIDEN THE CAP, deliberately. 6 of 11 blocking round artifacts carried only mixed-citation blockers, so the counterfactual is sized and recorded - but widening is a verification reduction reserved to the operator by spec decision 5 and the constitution's hard carve-out. The argument against is recorded beside the number: those rounds found real defects, not wording. Session 4's own round 1 found a false number in this session's headline deliverable (the round counter was counting operator-authorization ledger rows as verification rounds) and cited module, ledger and report together. A widened cap would have suppressed the finding that corrected this document.

(7) VERIFICATION: 3 blocking Majors across 2 discovery passes, all accepted and fixed, none disputed; VERIFIED on round 3 with 3 fix verdicts accepted. (a) The measurement did not cover all four sessions and its saved JSON was the prototype's shape - now regenerated from the shipped module, with --markdown added so the report's table is generated rather than hand-copied. (b) The round counter counted authorization rows as rounds, reporting 7 rounds for a session that ran 6 - fixed to count only round-completed events, with falsifiers in both directions. (c) The new cap test asserted corpus < cap as a permanent invariant, contradicting the shipped gate's corpus <= cap and so guaranteed to redden CI the moment the free slot was legitimately used - replaced with a guard on the DERIVATION (cap == the measured peak) plus the shipped semantics.

(8) NAMED RESIDUALS. The set shipped 151 net new test functions against a declared cap of 40 (S1's corpus_scan_guard suite 53, S2's guidance_ledger suite 76, S3 30, S4 12). Sessions 1-3 are closed and VERIFIED and their test files were outside Session 4's Touches, so this was surfaced to the operator rather than unwound or passed silently; operator ruled on 2026-08-15 to record it as a named residual and close. Also open: C-001 queued on its prerequisites, 29 subprocess call sites with no encoding=, and the 91%-Major severity scale, all out of scope by declaration.
